name: atr_channel_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY closes above its 2-minute ATR-adaptive Keltner Channel (EMA_24 + 2×ATR_24) with above-average volume on a 5-second bar, passive sell-side liquidity at that level has been fully absorbed by active institutional buyers. On NIFTY, these breakouts trigger momentum-following algorithms and delta-hedging from option market makers within seconds, producing a 10-20 spot point continuation impulse in the first 30-90 seconds. The ATR-adaptive channel ensures the breakout exceeds current intraday volatility noise, distinguishing genuine institutional flow from routine price oscillation around the channel midline. Low-VIX filter (VIX < 22) excludes stress regimes where breakouts reverse violently due to gap risk.
core_signal_oneliner: Close above 2-minute ATR-adaptive Keltner Channel upper band with relative volume surge, confirmed in low-VIX regime
